cases.label: string_concat_in_loop@K=3
cases.title: s = s .. x in a loop -> table.concat
cases.notes: I-039 found this is a regression at small K (0.57x at 3 iterations) and only reaches the doc figure at thousands; that is the whole point of @iters. Work here is O(K^2) per outer rep, so the budget is deliberately small.

cases.label: table_remove_tail@K=5
cases.title: table.remove(t) tail pop -> t[n]=nil; n=n-1
cases.notes: the arm destroys the table, so the K-element refill has to sit inside the timed region in BOTH arms. That shared cost dilutes the ratio - read this row as a lower bound on the win, not as the doc's undiluted 15.57x.
